name: 93013 · Carpinteria, CA
findings: ZIP 93013 (Carpinteria) has 85 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 93013 (Carpinteria) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 93013 (Carpinteria) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.
